 ATEEZ turn up the confidence on swagger-filled ‘Drip’ music video — watch
 SPINS 
 780 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 Photography by KQ Entertainment 
 First published: 23 October 2026 
 Last updated: 23 October 2026 
 News 
 Music 
 Video 
 Listen 
 ATEEZ are setting the tone for their next chapter with ‘Drip’ .
 Released on 23 October , the pre-release single arrives alongside a music video, offering a preview of the group’s forthcoming 15th EP, GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 .
 Built around a heavy trap rhythm, ‘Drip’ channels the eight-piece’s confidence into a declaration of their growing ambitions and artistic identity. Following ‘BAD’ , the track finds ATEEZ taking stock of their recent achievements while pushing ahead with characteristic swagger.
 Anticipation had been building before the release: the music video teaser, unveiled on 20 October, amassed more than 12 million views across platforms.
 GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 is due on 13 November at 2PM KST / 1PM SGT via Sony Music Korea/RCA Records . The EP is available to pre-order here .
